$comment: Every screenshot the guide uses. WRITTEN BY HAND, deliberately: this is
the allow list, so registering an image is the act that publishes it.
P7-d stage 2 considered generating it from a capture script and chose not
to -- a generator that appends whatever it just shot would publish by
default, which is the opposite of what the list is for.
scripts/build-docs.mjs reads it and fails the build when the guide
references an image that is not here, or an entry whose file is missing.
scripts/guide-images.mjs emits exactly the files listed here and nothing
else, so an unregistered image never reaches dist.
`route` and `scenario` are how the shot is reproduced. `capturedWith`
records the isolated environment, so a reader can tell that no production
data could have reached the picture.

capturedWith.session: fabricated; demo@example.test (.test is a reserved TLD)
capturedWith.note: No production Supabase, user, token or event was reachable.

gs-month-view.heading: カレンダーの3つの表示

alt.en: What someone opening a share link sees. A "How to read this" legend at the top explains that filled blocks are busy and hatched blocks are time the owner marked as open. Each day lists only a state and a time range, such as Busy 09:00–09:30 and Open 10:00–12:00. No event name appears anywhere

pa-share-dialog.heading: リンクを作る
pa-share-dialog.scenario: share dialog, creation form only (the existing-links list is sl-link-list)
pa-share-dialog.state: defaults as the app sets them: include_private ON, share_available OFF

alt.ja: 共有リンクの作成フォーム。ラベルの入力欄、非公開の予定を busy として含めるチェック（既定でオン）、空き時間として登録した予定も公開するチェック（既定でオフ）、その説明、有効期限、リンクを作成のボタンが並んでいる
alt.en: The share-link creation form, with a label field, a checkbox for including private events as busy (on by default), a checkbox for also sharing events marked as open time (off by default), the note beneath them, an expiry field and a create button

sl-created-url.heading: URLは作成時にしか表示されません

sl-link-list.heading: 作ったリンクを管理する
sl-link-list.state: two active links (one sharing open time), one expired but not revoked, one revoked; retaken in P8-finish-1: the expiry line carries the UTC offset of its instant (P8-c3.1)

alt.ja: 既存の共有リンクの一覧。各行にラベル、有効・期限切れ・失効済の状態、private を含むかと空き時間を公開するかの要約と、期限のある行では UTC からの時差付きの期限が並ぶ。有効な行には失効のボタンと空き時間公開の切り替えがあり、失効済みの行だけ削除のボタンが出ている。期限切れの行には先に失効するよう促す注意がある
alt.en: The list of existing share links. Each row shows a label, whether it is active, expired or revoked, and a summary of whether private events are included and open time is shared, with the expiry and its UTC offset on rows that have one. Active rows carry a revoke button and an open-time toggle; only the revoked row offers delete; the expired row says to revoke it first
